description: This file defines the final class RecipeRunner in the Drupal namespace, responsible for applying recipes including installation of modules, themes, configuration, and content, as well as triggering events and converting recipes into batch operations.

classes.name: RecipeRunner
classes.description: A static class responsible for processing and applying recipes, including installation of modules, themes, configuration, content, and event dispatching within Drupal.

methods.name: processRecipe
methods.description: Applies a given recipe by processing sub-recipes, installation, configuration, content, and triggering an event.

methods.name: triggerEvent
methods.description: Triggers the RecipeAppliedEvent and updates the context with a message and result.

methods.name: processRecipes
methods.description: Processes a list of recipes recursively.

methods.name: processInstall
methods.description: Installs modules and themes as specified in the recipe.

methods.name: processConfiguration
methods.description: Creates and applies configuration actions based on the recipe.

methods.name: processContent
methods.description: Imports content specified in the recipe.

methods.name: toBatchOperations
methods.description: Converts a recipe into batch operations for processing.

methods.name: toBatchOperationsRecipe
methods.description: Helper to convert a recipe and its sub-recipes into batch operations.

methods.name: toBatchOperationsInstall
methods.description: Converts install tasks of a recipe into batch operations.

methods.name: installModule
methods.description: Installs a module for a recipe, overriding configuration storage if needed.

methods.name: installTheme
methods.description: Installs a theme for a recipe, overriding configuration storage if needed.

methods.name: replaceInputValues
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in data with provided input values.
